claims.scope: For k(r)=K(r,1), k is even, nonnegative and increasing, 2 ln(1+|r|)-1 <= k(r) <= 2 ln(1+|r|)+3, and k(r)-k(s) <= 4+2 ln(1+|r-s|) for all real r,s.
hypotheses: no Boolean realizability assumption is needed for this scalar lemma

claims.scope: For every genuine Boolean disjoint splice, every c>0, and every child node, the near region |a_T+mu b_T|<=c|alpha b_T| has the signed upper bound alpha^2 sum b_T^2[k(c)-k(|mu|/|alpha|)], while every separated coefficient obeys the uniform bound alpha^2 b_T^2[4+2 ln(1+|a_T|/(|alpha b_T|))].

For a fixed Boolean outer pair a±b and any Boolean child h with any adaptive nonreusing physical restriction tree, sum_v w_v R_{mu_v}(alpha_v) <= [M(a,b)+(4+2 ln2+2/e)q] I(h), where q=sum b_T^2 and M=2 sum b_T^2 ln_+(|a_T|/|b_T|).
hypotheses: outer pair a+b,a-b consists of genuine Boolean signs
the child block is disjoint from the outer block
the same outer pair is used throughout the child restriction tree
each physical child coordinate is queried at most once per root-leaf path
